description: In Nevada, Starlink showed 100 Mbps at $38.50 a month with a $0 rental kit. See the US and UK numbers, how the $100 referral fits in and what to check first.

contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: New customers can get a $100 bill credit in the US or £40 in the UK. Open our referral link before you order, check that the reward is shown, and keep your eligible subscription paid and active for two full billing cycles.

Starlink's Black Friday offer takes 30% off the monthly plan in select areas, with a $0 rental kit that you return if you cancel. In Nevada the 100 Mbps plan was $38.50 a month, with $20 plus taxes due today. The offer runs until November 30.

contentSections.heading: The numbers: 100 Mbps, 200 Mbps and Max in Nevada and the UK
paragraphs: We read the order pages on November 23, 2026, without completing a purchase. In Nevada, Residential 100 Mbps was $38.50 a month (regular price $55), 200 Mbps was $59.50 ($85) and Max was $91 ($130), all with a $0 rental kit. The order summary for 100 Mbps showed $20 plus taxes due today, which is the shipping, because the Starlink V5 and Router Mini rental was $349 minus $349.

In the UK, the order summary showed £40, £60 and £80 a month for 100 Mbps, 200 Mbps and Max, a £0 rental kit, £19 due today and no contracts. Through our link, the referral reward is $100 in the US and £40 in the UK, paid after two monthly cycles. That is more than two and a half months of the Nevada 100 Mbps price, or a full month in the UK. The credit does not reduce the price of the kit.

contentSections.heading: What the order looks like
paragraphs: The screenshot shows “Referral Code Applied” and a displayed offer of $100 each for the new customer and the referrer. Starlink checks eligibility before the reward is paid.
To check your own offer, open the link, enter your address and look for the same notice before you pay. See whether the order shows the reward and the monthly price.

contentSections.heading: Does the offer apply at your address?
paragraphs: The 30% applies in select areas and depends on the address you enter, so two addresses can see different prices on the same day. Put in yours and compare the monthly price, the kit, the installation and the shipping time.
The Nevada screen below is the 100 Mbps tab: $38.50 a month, the Starlink V5 with a Router Mini at $0 upfront and $0 a month, and the note that you must return the rental if you cancel service.

contentSections.heading: Rental kit, cancelling and the 30-day test
paragraphs: The kit is a rental, and the order says you must return the hardware if you cancel. The refund terms cover cancelling service and returning the kit undamaged within 30 days of the payment due date, with the kit and the first month refunded. That is why opening the order costs nothing: you see your own price, test the dish on your roof and only then decide to stay.

After that window there is no contract. The order summary says there is no fixed duration, and Starlink may change prices with 30 days' notice. See the [contract, cancellation and refund guide](/en/reviews/starlink-contract-cancel-refund).

contentSections.heading: After the promotion: how to protect your price
paragraphs: The 30% is for orders placed until November 30. Starlink's FAQ says the monthly price has no fixed duration and that prices can change with 30 days' notice, so the discounted price is not guaranteed for any set number of months. Plan around the regular price if you intend to stay for years.

Save a screenshot of the order summary with the price, the kit line and the referral notice before you pay, and compare your first invoice with it. If a bill does not match, open a support request from your account and attach the screenshot.

contentSections.heading: What is it worth to refer someone?
paragraphs: After you subscribe you can refer other people, and the person who refers gets the same amount, in cash or as service credit. The person you refer has to complete the required cycles before the reward is paid.
See [how the referral program works](/en/reviews/starlink-referral-link-how-it-works) and check in your account what each referral is worth.

contentSections.heading: 4 mistakes that cost you the reward
paragraphs: Even after clicking the link, the reward is lost by small slips:
bullets: Buying the kit from a marketplace or a retailer and trying to use the link afterwards. A referral only counts on an order placed on starlink.com through a referral link, before payment.

Opening the link on your phone and finishing the order hours later on another device without opening the link again. The referral may not follow the order: place it all on one device, or reopen the link and look for the green notice.
Signing up with a name, email or address that already had a Starlink account. The reward is for new customers.
Cancelling or paying late before two full monthly cycles are paid. The reward only lands while the service is active and up to date.
postParagraphs: If you have already paid without the link, the referral cannot be added afterwards.

contentSections.heading: How to use the link
paragraphs: Opening the link commits you to nothing: prices, availability and the offer only appear after you type your address. Enter the address where you will install the dish, pick the plan, check that the referral shows as applied and save the offer that appears before you pay.
The [Starlink referral page](/en/coupons/starlink) has the link and the program rules.

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: Does Starlink have a discount code? No. Starlink has no coupon: through Cecília's referral link, a new subscriber gets $100 in the US and £40 in the UK after two months of service, as a credit on the bill, and the person who referred gets the same amount.

Does Starlink have a Black Friday deal? Yes. The order pages we read show 30% off service plans in select areas for orders until the end of November, with a $0 rental kit. In Nevada that puts 100 Mbps at $38.50 a month.

Does the referral stack with the offer? Yes. The plan offer and the referral are separate lines on the order, and the Nevada order with our link showed the $100 reward next to $20 plus taxes due today. The reward depends on eligibility and two paid monthly cycles.
Is there a 200 Mbps plan in the offer? Yes. In Nevada it was $59.50 a month instead of $85, with a $0 rental kit and $0 professional installation.
Is the Starlink kit free? It is a rental, with $0 upfront and $0 a month, and you have to return it if you cancel.
Can I try Starlink before committing? Yes. Starlink refunds the kit and the first month if you cancel and return the kit undamaged within 30 days of the payment due date.
Can I add the referral after paying? No. It only counts on an order opened through the link, before payment.
How long does the offer run? Starlink advertises it until the end of November. Enter your address on the order page to see whether it is available.
